transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately?

Hi. Well, I’m here because the thought of seeing a rat has gotten so bad that I can’t do parts of my cleaning job anymore. I clean buildings for a living, and... it's just getting too hard. Even when I tell myself it’s probably just an old building or a normal trash room, and it's not really dangerous, I just can't bring myself to go in there.
Is your fear limited only to rats, or do you find yourself feeling anxious about other things as well?
No, it's really just rats. I don't have any problems with spiders or heights or... anything else, really. Just the rats.
How long have you felt this way about rats, and do you find yourself avoiding places or situations even when there’s no sign of a rat being there?

It’s been going on for about two years now. It started right around the time I moved into this older apartment building... people there kept talking about rats being around, and it just really got to me. 

And, yeah, to answer your other question, I definitely avoid places even if I haven't actually seen one. Like at work, if it's a basement or a dumpster area where they *might* be, I just... I won't go in. I can't risk it, even if there's no sign of them at all.
